title: Cap line-port replicas at one unpaid coordinate per family
body:
## Summary
- Eight paying calls clear eight label columns, and the dirty bit stays 1. A ninth column keeps rank 1.
- With 112 ports, nine calls and one offset, the cap is `112 * 8 = 896`, equal to the number of live families. Two unpaid coordinates per family would be 1792.
- The selected exponent is unchanged.

## Test plan
